name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-copilot-components-zava-revenue-deal-room
title: ZavaMesh Revenue Deal Room
shortDescription: A ZavaMesh-branded revenue Copilot App with global analytics, guided deal intake and human-governed approvals.
longDescription: ZavaMesh Revenue Deal Room turns natural-language sales intent into focused, inspectable work across account discovery, qualification, buyer influence, risk, commitments, proposals, commercial scenarios, exceptions, forecast, and customer success handoff.

Twenty-six operational components and one capability explorer support personal-priority revenue briefs, country opportunity and recorded-spend maps, fictional pipeline and approval value flows, exact commercial-to-submission handoffs and independent approval. Four polished full-screen workspaces separate purposeful landings from explicitly selected work, preserve exact scenario context and carry a keynote story from seller priority to accountable decision.

The sample is deterministic, offline, responsive, and explicit that confirmed actions are session-only demonstrations. Buyer facts, seller judgment, stale evidence, deterministic output, contrary evidence, and inference remain visibly distinct.
